title: Chlorine and chloramine maximum residual disinfectant levels: 4.0 mg/L as Cl2, running annual average

claims.subject: Routine residual disinfectant monitoring for chlorine and chloramines
claims.value: Measure the residual disinfectant level in the distribution system at the same point and at the same time as total coliforms are sampled (since April 1, 2016 under 141.854 through 141.858); subpart H systems may use the residual results taken under 141.74(b)(6)(i) or 141.74(c)(3)(i) instead of separate samples
conditions: Before April 1, 2016 the coliform sampling points were those specified in 141.21 (141.132(c)(1)(i), first sentence)
